codeReview.summary: The feature only added deterministic test coverage and continuity updates; it did not fix the live Next.js dev runtime behavior required by the feature. The committed code leaves the known app-host guest-route failure unresolved, so the implementation does not satisfy the feature's expectedBehavior.

issues.description: The only functional change is a new unit assertion for `handleRouting`; no production/runtime code was changed to make the live `app.localhost` request redirect correctly. The feature description and expected behavior require fixing the real runtime path on port 3000, but the handoff itself confirms the browser still hits `ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS` and curl still returns a relative `location: /guest/...` header.
The commit includes a mission continuity-ledger rewrite unrelated to runtime behavior. It does not help deliver the feature and adds review noise to an otherwise test-only change.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The repo already documents the exact local runtime limitation and required fallback for VAL-FOUNDATION-013, but the worker still spent significant effort re-proving it. This knowledge should be treated as canonical mission state during review and triage.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The guest-routing-worker skill assumes successful live browser verification when the runtime supports it, but this mission has a documented local-dev exception.
